items.context: What action would you like to take right now?

items.text: I am seeing a debit of two thousand rupees from my account
there is a transaction for seven hundred rupees at a store in mumbai
my name is Ravi Kumar and I did not make this payment
the unauthorized debit happened yesterday evening around seven pm
can you please check the transaction on fourteenth March from Bangalore
the amount debited is five thousand five hundred and I do not recognize it

items.context: Can you confirm the date on which the transaction took place?
items.text: could you please verify the transaction date for me

items.context: Where did the transaction happen according to the statement?
items.text: I have never been to Chennai where the transaction occurred

items.context: Do you recognize the merchant where the debit happened?
items.text: the debit of six hundred rupees is from a shop I never visited

items.context: Which merchant was involved in the disputed transaction?
items.text: please tell me the merchant details for the debit on twenty ninth April
I was checking my bank statement this morning and noticed a debit of fifteen thousand rupees which I did not authorize at all
my debit card was used in Delhi on 12th February for a large purchase that I did not make so please block the card immediately

items.context: Can you describe the transaction that you believe is unauthorized?
items.text: I see a transaction of eight thousand rupees on the 10th of March at a electronics store in Hyderabad which is completely unknown to me can you help

items.context: Can you tell me the details of the disputed transaction you found?
items.text: the debit card ending 9876 was charged for a transaction in Kolkata last Sunday and I am sure I was not there on that day so please revoke the transaction

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: banking
Intent: unauthorised_debit - reports a transaction they did not make
Language: Indian English, Latin script.
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 18 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 2 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'yes please', 'tomorrow', 'card ending 4321'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 2 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 6 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 4 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 2 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 2 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
